title: the Fens Rising
author: I. M. Nakamura
blurb: Oscar Reyes, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
